mapper.select: SELECT PAYMENT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, PAYMENT_DATE, PAID_AMOUNT, TOTAL_PREMIUM, PAY_STATUS, CONTRACT_ID FROM ( SELECT pay.PAYMENT_ID, p.PRODUCT_NAME, pay.PAYMENT_DATE, pay.PAID_AMOUNT, c.TOTAL_PREMIUM, pay.PAY_STATUS, pay.CONTRACT_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pay.CONTRACT_ID ORDER BY pay.PAYMENT_DATE DESC) AS rn FROM payments pay JOIN insurance_contracts c ON pay.CONTRACT_ID = c.CONTRACT_ID JOIN insurance_products p ON c.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID WHERE pay.CUSTOMER_ID = #{customer_id} AND c.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ) WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY PAYMENT_DATE DESC
mapper.insert: insert into payments (payment_id, customer_id, contract_id, paid_amount, payment_date, pay_status, unpaid_id) values ( payment_seq.nextval, #{customer_id}, #{contract_id}, #{paid_amount}, SYSDATE, 'P', 1 )
mapper.update: UPDATE PAYMENTS SET paid_amount = #{paid_amount}, payment_date = SYSDATE, pay_status = 'P' WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId}
